question: Vishu is one of the very famous festivals of which of the following states of India ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vishu marks the beginning of the New Year for the people of Kerala. 
 
• The festival is celebrated in the month of Medam of the Malayalam calendar with much pomp and vigour.
 
• The most important part of the festival is the Vishukani.
 
• Apart from Kerala, the festival is celebrated in neighbouring regions like Mangalore, Tulunadu, and Udupi.
 
• Vishu is also called the festival of fireworks and light as the celebration includes the bursting of firecrackers. It is said that Krishna killed the demon Narakasur on the day of Vishu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Festivals of Kerala:

 
 
• Onam:

 
 
• It is a harvest festival celebrated in Kerala
 
 
 
• Vishu: 
 
 
• The festival marks the first day of Medam which is the ninth month in the solar calendar followed in Kerala.
 
 
 
• Thiruvathira: 
 
 
• The festival falls on the asterism Thiruvathira in the Malayalam month of Dhanu (December-January) and this is also the longest night in the year.
 
• This festival is celebrated in commemoration of the death of Kamadeva, the mythological God of love.
